_comment: Keys read by the daily self-review. install.sh merges missing keys into ~/.claude/quartermaster/config.json and never overwrites a value you set. notify_command is a shell command run when the self-review has something to tell you. It receives two environment variables: SUBJECT (one line) and BODY_FILE (path to a text file with the message: the full report after a run, or a short notice). The body is in the report file, so a notification only needs to point to it. Leave notify_command empty to get no notification; the report file is then the only record. Example for macOS: osascript -e 'display notification "Quartermaster wrote a new report" with title "'"$SUBJECT"'"'  Example for email, using any mail command you already have: mail -s "$SUBJECT" you@example.com < "$BODY_FILE"
